MDG.note: The notice says nothing about a business register.

facts.fact: The Fonds d'Intervention pour le Développement, under the World Bank-financed Projet Filets de Sécurité et de Résilience, opened a consultation on 30 July 2025 (bids due 19 August 2025) for payment services for the FSP cash transfers by QR code on the PGP platform, in two lots covering six communes of Benenitra district.

MDG.note: The notice gives no survey figure on account holding.
The notice is about government cash-transfer payments, not mobile money or retail payments between people.
The notice says nothing about tax or fee payment.
The notice states no data link between social protection systems.
The notice names a payment platform, not a programme management information system.
